Dark waves crash below  
A steady beam cuts the night  
Guiding ships to home  

The first line contrasts the chaotic sea with the lighthouse’s calm, persistent light, suggesting danger and stability. The beam becomes a guiding path, turning darkness into a route toward safety and home.

Stone finger of night  
turning eye sweeps the black sea  
ships find home in light  

The lighthouse is imagined as a stone finger and a turning eye, giving it a watchful, almost living presence against the darkness. Its sweeping beam becomes a path of safety, turning the threatening sea into a route home for ships.
